tiers.name: Wipeout
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}}'s attempt collapses badly. If an opponent is present, their skill, Quirk or plan turns it; otherwise the situation does. A Quirk use may backfire through the character's Drawback. It is a hard setback, not the end of the scene.]

tiers.name: Not Yet
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}}'s attempt fails. Credit an opponent's skill or the situation where one applies, and leave a way to try again.]

tiers.name: Pushed Through
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} gets part of the goal and pays for it: more Strain, a minor injury, damaged gear, a witness or lost time. In a supervised test or drill that is not a fight (the Quirk Apprehension Test, fitness tests, races, exams), the cost is a lower score, more Strain, lost time or a minor strain the character does to their own body by pushing it (a pulled muscle, a Drawback flare); a classmate never injures them there.]

tiers.name: Pulled It Off
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}}'s action works, plainly and without flourish.]

tiers.name: Go Beyond!
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} goes beyond what anyone expected: faster, cleaner or with an extra benefit, and the people who see it take notice.]

tiers.name: PLUS ULTRA!
tiers.prompt: [Note: {{characterName}} goes beyond their limits: the action succeeds in the most striking way their Quirk, skill and gear allow, a moment people will remember. It never grants a power the character does not have and never skips a Drawback.]
